verdict.rationale: Conductor documents an API for managing cloud workspaces programmatically and a hosted MCP server, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence mentions API versioning or a deprecation policy, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Having an API is not the same as having a versioned API with a documented deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
